name: OAIY Voice
description: OAIY's own voice for calls, in Rust (on the CPU for now): Parakeet speech-to-text and Qwen3-TTS speech that streams as it is made, in a voice cloned from a short clip (an MP3 or WAV, chosen on the Calendar page). Served locally over the OpenAI /v1/audio/transcriptions and /v1/audio/speech APIs. Uses the models already in your model folders, or downloads them (~4.3 GB, checksum-verified).
